title: 1965 February, new Canadian flag raised at the town hall by Mayor Arden Never
description: On February 15, 1965, the new single red maple leaf flag was raised at the town hall by Mayor Arden Nevers. This replaced the Canadian Red ensign, which included the Union Jack; many veterans opposed it because they had fought under it. The Hartland High School students marched down from the school to observe this memorial event.
